maddeler.e:
نستحوذ (form X)
# نَسْتَحْوِذُ (nastaḥwiḏu) /nas.taħ.wi.ðu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْوَذَ (istaḥwaḏa)
# نَسْتَحْوِذَ (nastaḥwiḏa) /nas.taħ.wi.ða/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَحْوَذَ (istaḥwaḏa)
# نَسْتَحْوِذْ (nastaḥwiḏ) /nas.taħ.wið/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَحْوَذَ (istaḥwaḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
